tools.name: faveo_get_authenticated_user
tools.description: Return the Faveo user the connection logs in as: name, role, email and status. Use it to confirm the connection works.

tools.name: faveo_list_open_tickets
tools.description: List open tickets that are answered or not, 10 per page. Use page to read more. Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/open.

tools.name: faveo_list_unassigned_tickets
tools.description: List open tickets that no agent has taken yet, 10 per page. Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/unassigned.

tools.name: faveo_list_closed_tickets
tools.description: List closed tickets, 10 per page. Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/closed.

tools.name: faveo_get_ticket
tools.description: Return one ticket with its status, priority, department, owner and dates. Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/ticket.

tools.name: faveo_get_ticket_thread
tools.description: Return the messages of one ticket: customer replies, agent replies and internal notes. Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/ticket-thread.

tools.name: faveo_search_tickets
tools.description: Search tickets by text (subject, body or ticket number). Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/ticket-search.

tools.name: faveo_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, optionally filtered by a search text (name or email). Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/customers.

tools.name: faveo_get_customer
tools.description: Return one customer's profile by user id. Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/customer.

tools.name: faveo_list_agents
tools.description: List the support agents of the instance. Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/agents.

tools.name: faveo_list_teams
tools.description: List the agent teams of the instance. Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/teams.

tools.name: faveo_list_help_topics
tools.description: List the help topics. Their ids go into faveo_create_ticket. Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/help-topic.

tools.name: faveo_list_sla_plans
tools.description: List the SLA plans. Their ids go into faveo_create_ticket. Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/sla-plan.

tools.name: faveo_list_priorities
tools.description: List the ticket priorities. Their ids go into faveo_create_ticket. Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/priority.

tools.name: faveo_list_departments
tools.description: List the departments. Their ids go into faveo_create_ticket. Faveo API: GET /api/v1/helpdesk/department.

tools.name: faveo_create_ticket
tools.description: Create a new ticket for a customer. Faveo may email the customer. Use the ids from the list tools for help topic, SLA plan and priority. Faveo API: POST /api/v1/helpdesk/create.

tools.name: faveo_reply_to_ticket
tools.description: Post a reply on a ticket as the logged-in agent. Faveo emails the reply to the customer. Faveo API: POST /api/v1/helpdesk/reply.

tools.name: faveo_add_internal_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a ticket. Customers do not see it. The note is written as the logged-in agent. Faveo API: POST /api/v1/helpdesk/internal-note.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: faveo_get_authenticated_user, faveo_list_open_tickets, faveo_list_unassigned_tickets, faveo_list_closed_tickets, faveo_get_ticket, faveo_get_ticket_thread, faveo_search_tickets, faveo_list_customers, faveo_list_priorities, faveo_create_ticket · Public sink: faveo_get_authenticated_user, faveo_list_customers, faveo_create_ticket, faveo_reply_to_ticket, faveo_add_internal_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: faveo_get_authenticated_user, faveo_list_open_tickets, faveo_list_unassigned_tickets, faveo_list_closed_tickets, faveo_get_ticket, faveo_get_ticket_thread, faveo_search_tickets, faveo_list_customers, faveo_list_priorities, faveo_create_ticket · Public sink: faveo_get_authenticated_user, faveo_list_customers, faveo_create_ticket, faveo_reply_to_ticket, faveo_add_internal_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
